definitions.explanation: A voucher that entitles the holder to a discount on purchases or services.

examples.japanese: {割引券|わりびきけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦{二十|にじゅう}→二十：00975_nijuu⟧⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧{割引券|わりびきけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{割引券|わりびきけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{有効|ゆうこう}→有効：03645_yuukou⟧です。
examples.english: This discount coupon is valid until next month.

notes:
A voucher or ticket that entitles the holder to a price reduction. Commonly distributed by stores, restaurants, and online retailers.

ETYMOLOGY:
Compound of ⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧ (discount) + ⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧ (ticket/voucher).

- {割引券|わりびきけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧: to receive a coupon
- {割引券|わりびきけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配|くば}る→配る：03921_kubaru⟧: to hand out coupons
